name: Team Squirtle: Bulky Fortresses & Priority Strikers
archetype: Water/Flying aerial bulky pivot, colossal Special tanks, and Intimidate priority wallbreakers.
gym_duel_rationale: Overcoming Sabrina's psychic supremacy requires exceptional special bulk and decisive Dark/Ghost coverage. Enter the 4v4 duel with Snorlax (540 BST behemoth whose 160 HP and 110 SpD wall Sabrina's entire lineup while dismantling foes with Body Slam and Bite), Alakazam/Weezing (495 BST Levitate pivot matching Sabrina's special speed and firing STAB Psychic and Sludge Bomb), Arcanine/Primeape (527 BST Intimidate breaker wielding super-effective Crunch and +2 Extreme Speed priority to pick off weakened sweepers), and Blastoise/Fearow (Water/Flying aerial anchor carrying super-effective Bite, STAB Drill Peck, and Roost recovery).

roster.progression_notes: 490 BST fortress with 95 Defense and 93 Speed. Immune to Ground moves. Super-effective Bite damages Sabrina's Psychic foes while Roost provides dependable longevity.
540 BST titan with 160 HP and 110 SpD. Thick Fat provides Fire and Ice resistance. Amnesia boosts Special Defense into unbreachable heights while Body Slam cripples fast psychics.

roster.status: Active in Party (Evolved with Linking Cord)
roster.progression_notes: 495 BST special powerhouse with 118 SpA and 98 Speed. Levitate grants Ground immunity. Outspeeds Sabrina's Hypno/Mr. Mime and Slowbro while setting up Calm Mind.
527 BST offensive juggernaut with 107 Attack and 95 Speed. Extreme Speed offers +2 priority revenge killing, and Crunch provides reliable Dark coverage against Psychic types.

roster.status: Active in Party (Honedge evolved at Lv. 35)
roster.progression_notes: 477 BST fortress with 120 Defense and 100 Attack. Quad-resists Poison and resists 8 other types. Shadow Sneak provides vital Ghost priority while Iron Head punishes Fairy types.
465 BST dual-threat with 105 Speed. Sleep Powder shuts down enemy leads, Sucker Punch provides dark priority, and Giga Drain punishes Water foes.

flex_bench.progression_notes: 535 BST tank with 130 HP. Free gift from Silph Co. Water Absorb completely neutralizes water attacks.
455 BST martial artist with 105 Attack. Iron Fist powers up all elemental punches, granting versatile super-effective coverage against every gym.
